description:
**CVRP tabu interroute relocate with record-triggered tail improvement.** Use a complete symmetric matrix and a feasible savings solution. Enumerate capacity-feasible relocations with the moved customer as the tabu attribute.

Select the cheapest authorized move, including worse moves when allowed. A tabu move may pass by strictly improving the best objective. Record the moved customer for a fixed tenure.

A new record triggers a 2-opt* tail-improvement scan before updating the best route set. This keeps new records feasible and illustrates reactive intensification without reproducing TABUROUTE's infeasible-solution strategy.
